message.reasoning_content: Now self-check with a script validating the JSON: 6 keys match filenames, values in vocabulary.

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "cd "$(pwd)" && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os
vocab = {"off_by_one","mutable_default","shadowed_builtin","wrong_except","integer_division","unclosed_resource"}
d = json.load(open("findings.json"))
files = sorted(f for f in os.listdir("src") if f.endswith(".py"))
print("files on disk:", files)
print("keys in json :", sorted(d))
assert sorted(d) == files, "key mismatch"
assert all(v in vocab for v in d.values()), "bad value"
assert len(set(d.values())) == 6, "duplicate values"
print("OK: 6 files, all values in vocab, all distinct")
for k,v in d.items(): print(f"  {k}: {v}")
EOF"}
